## Batch 95 complete

Authored nine draft items and the two frontmatter-only pages. The proofs establish the rank bound and SVD factorization for rank-at-most-\(r\) updates, the factor change-of-basis symmetry, the gradients \(\nabla_B L=cGA^\mathsf{T}\) and \(\nabla_A L=cB^\mathsf{T}G\), and exact real-arithmetic merging. The finite gradient-descent procedure makes no convergence claim.

The assigned sources—[Hu et al.](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.09685), [MIT OCW lecture notes](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/18-s096-matrix-calculus-for-machine-learning-and-beyond-january-iap-2023/mit18_s096iap23_lec08.pdf), and [Axler §7E](https://linear.axler.net/LADR4e.pdf)—are recorded and fetch-verified in [batch 95 coverage](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-95.coverage.json).

**Validation:** all nine Step-1 records are `ready`, `owner:false`, and current-hash closed. Precheck, proof layout (22 steps, 0 defects), rendering, strict proof contracts, citation fidelity, focused dependency checks, and content policy passed.

The run remains at `1-scaffold` with 67/101 covered and an existing owner hold. Whole-run dependency checks are blocked by 40 empty inventories in other batches and malformed YAML in Batch 85’s `ex-matched-observation-mrps-have-distinct-bellman-errors.md:24`. I also recorded the shared-plan row that lists ML-87 as an EM/CV consumer, which conflicts with this pair’s low-rank-adaptation design. These owner issues are documented in [batch 95 notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-95.notes.md); I left the other pair, shared plan, and engine state unchanged. Independent review and native stage closeout remain outstanding.
